form.name: Price Plan Name
form.scheduleLockedTooltip: This price plan is bound to {{.ClientName}}'s price schedule.
form.scheduleAutoCreateHint: No price schedule exists for {{.ClientName}} yet — one will be created automatically when you save.
form.scheduleAutoReuseHint: This price plan will be added to the existing price schedule for {{.ClientName}}.
form.scheduleClientPickerNotice: Only plans assigned to this client are available below.
form.scheduleGeneralPickerNotice: Plans assigned specifically to clients are not available for assignment to general-scope price schedules.
form.parentScheduleClientNotice: This price schedule belongs to {{.ClientName}}. Price plans created here will be available only for engagements with this client.
form.billingKindOneTimeHint: Charged once at signup. No further invoices fire on this subscription.
form.billingKindRecurringHint: Billed every cycle. Auto-renews until the operator cancels the subscription.
form.billingKindContractHint: Fixed-term commitment with a defined end date. Can bill periodically within the term or as a single total at signup.
form.billingKindMilestoneHint: Invoice fires per milestone (engagement phase) as work completes. Requires a JobTemplate on the parent Plan.
form.billingKindAdHocHint: Operator-requested usage occurrences (visits, appointments, support calls). Choose Total Package for a prepaid pool or Per Occurrence for pay-per-call.
form.amountBasisPerCycleHint: Amount charged each billing cycle. Required for Recurring and Contract-with-cycle plans.
form.amountBasisTotalPackageHint: Single total amount charged across the full term. One invoice covers everything; no per-cycle billing.
form.amountBasisDerivedFromLinesHint: Total computed automatically from the per-item ProductPricePlan rows. Amount input is hidden when this is selected.
form.amountBasisPerOccurrenceHint: Amount charged per delivered usage. Pay-as-you-go only — each occurrence fires its own invoice.
form.entitledOccurrencesInfo: Number of usage occurrences (visits, appointments, support calls) included in the prepaid pool. Required when amount basis is Total Package on a Pay-as-you-go plan.
form.termOpenEndedHelp: Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration
form.planInfo: The plan this price plan belongs to. Locked from the parent page.
form.scheduleInfo: The price schedule (date range + location) this price plan belongs to.
form.nameInfo: Optional — defaults to the plan name when left blank.
form.descriptionInfo: Optional notes shown alongside the price plan in detail views.
form.billingKindInfo: One-time = charged once. Recurring = billed every cycle. Fixed-term = recurring with an end date. Milestone = invoice fires per phase. Pay-as-you-go = operator-requested usage occurrences (pool or per-occurrence).
form.amountBasisInfo: Per cycle = amount charged each billing cycle. Total package = amount charged across the full term. Sum of items = derived from the per-item breakdown. Per occurrence = amount charged per delivered usage (Pay-as-you-go only).
form.amountInfo: Price in the selected currency. For Sum of items, this is computed automatically.
form.currencyInfo: Currency applied to this price plan and any auto-seeded product price plans.
form.billingCycleInfo: How often the recurring charge is issued (e.g. every 1 month).
form.termInfo: How long the engagement lasts. Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration.
form.activeInfo: Inactive price plans stay on record but are hidden from new subscriptions.

validation.request_required: Request is required for rate cards
validation.plan_id_required: Plan selection is required for rate cards
validation.location_id_required: Location selection is required for rate cards
validation.amount_required: Amount is required for rate cards
validation.milestoneCyclicBlock: Milestone billing is not supported on cyclic plans (RECURRING / CONTRACT × PER_CYCLE / multi-visit).
validation.adHocInvalidBasis: Pay-as-you-go plans require amount basis = Total Package (pool) or Per Occurrence (pay-per-call).
validation.adHocBillingIncompatibleWithCycleCadence: Pay-as-you-go plans cannot have a billing cycle.

totalPackage.customer: Pays {{.Amount}} once at signup. No further charges.
totalPackage.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime Job with phases (if Plan has a JobTemplate).
totalPackage.revenue: One Revenue at Subscription.Create covering the full amount.

perCycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}}. Subscription auto-renews until cancelled.
perCycle.operations: Each cycle spawns {{.VisitsPerCycle}} cycle Job(s) (if Plan has a JobTemplate). Operations tab shows cycle accordions.
perCycle.revenue: One Revenue per cycle. Recognize Revenue creates the invoice and (via piggyback) spawns the cycle Job if missing.

derivedFromLines.customer: Charged the sum of itemised lines every {{.CycleLabel}}.
derivedFromLines.operations: Each cycle spawns 1+ cycle Jobs. Operations tracking flows through Plan's JobTemplate.
derivedFromLines.revenue: Revenue total computed from ProductPricePlan rows; one Revenue per cycle.

perCycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}} for {{.TermLength}}. Auto-deactivates at term end.
perCycle.operations: Same as recurring + the engagement closes when the {{.TermLength}} term completes.
perCycle.revenue: Same as recurring. Operator can extend the term to spawn additional cycles.

totalPackage.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime Job (or cycle Jobs if cyclic — see Plan's visits_per_cycle).
totalPackage.revenue: One Revenue at signup; cycle Jobs are operational only.

totalPackage.customer: Pays {{.Amount}} total. Invoice fires per milestone (engagement phase) as work completes.
totalPackage.operations: Lifetime engagement Job with phases. BillingEvent rows gate per-milestone invoicing.
totalPackage.revenue: Revenue per milestone trigger; sum across milestones equals the total package.

totalPackage.customer: Pays {{.Amount}} upfront for {{.EntitledOccurrences}} usage occurrences (e.g. service visits, appointments, support calls).
totalPackage.operations: Operator requests each usage from the Operations tab. Pool exhausts after {{.EntitledOccurrences}} usages — operator can extend.
totalPackage.revenue: One Revenue at signup covering the whole pool; subsequent usages are operationally tracked only.

perOccurrence.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} per usage occurrence. No upfront cost.
perOccurrence.operations: Operator requests each usage from the Operations tab. Each completed usage flips its BillingEvent to READY for invoicing.
perOccurrence.revenue: One Revenue per delivered usage. Recognize Revenue per usage row.

warning.milestoneNoTemplate: Milestone billing requires the Plan to have a JobTemplate. Configure it on the Plan first.
warning.recurringNoTemplate: This subscription will not have operational tracking. Add a JobTemplate to the Plan to enable cycle Jobs.
warning.visitsPerCycleInvalidKind: visits_per_cycle is only valid for cyclic plans. Reset to 1 or change the billing kind.
warning.adHocPoolNoTemplate: AD_HOC pool plans require the Plan to have a JobTemplate so usages can be tracked. Configure it on the Plan first.
warning.adHocPerCallNoTemplate: AD_HOC pay-per-call plans require the Plan to have a JobTemplate so usages can be tracked. Configure it on the Plan first.
warning.adHocNoEntitlement: AD_HOC pool plans need entitled occurrences > 0. Set the value or switch to per-occurrence billing.
warning.adHocBillingCycleNotAllowed: AD_HOC plans are event-driven, not calendar-driven. Remove the billing cycle or change the billing kind.
warning.adHocVisitsPerCycleNotAllowed: AD_HOC plans cannot use multi-visit cycles. Reset visits_per_cycle to 1 or change the billing kind.
